integrity: Claims rely on a complete symbolic proof of reflection containment, the sharp asymmetry bound, all center cuts and dimension; standalone finite exact-arithmetic checks are only corroboration. All source dates refer to first public versions.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to complete-graph spanning-tree/base polytopes; does not establish the corresponding formula for arbitrary graphs, other matroids or Euclidean ellipsoid metrics. Finite verification does not prove all dimensions. Bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
title: Minkowski centers of complete-graph spanning-tree polytopes and the exceptional six-vertex cut
